summary: Iteration 50 - Category Import/Export, Templates, and Batch Payout System Testing Complete. All 28 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: Settings page shows Category Management with Import/Export buttons, all 5 category templates available via API.
critical_code_review_comments: Category Export API (/api/category-transfer/export) returns categories with metadata including version, exported_at, exporter info
Category Export Download (/api/category-transfer/export/download) returns downloadable JSON file with proper Content-Disposition header
Category Import API (/api/category-transfer/import) supports 3 merge strategies: skip, replace, merge
Category Templates API (/api/category-transfer/templates) returns 5 pre-made templates: research, news, business, tech, personal
Import Template API (/api/category-transfer/import-template/{id}) allows importing pre-made templates directly
Share to Marketplace API (/api/category-transfer/share-to-marketplace) creates marketplace listings from category bundles
Batch Payout API (/api/marketplace/admin/payout-batch) returns users ready for payout with batch_id and total_amount
Process Batch Payout API (/api/marketplace/admin/process-batch-payout) processes multiple payouts at once
Payout Settings API (/api/marketplace/admin/payout-settings) allows configuring auto_payout_enabled, batch_limit, etc.
Settings page UI shows Import/Export section with 'Export JSON' and 'Import JSON' buttons
Category Management shows 16 categories with tree structure and Public badges
All admin-only endpoints properly require authentication and admin role
